scope: Offline structural reconciliation of retained Gnd485 architecture snapshots. Does not reread hardware or memory contents; allocator labels do not independently identify buffer use.

checks: Every parsed block size equals inclusive address extent.
Blocks are page aligned and lie in exactly one recorded zone.
All recorded blocks form a contiguous range from 0x30000000 through 0x349dffff.
Block count, used size and aggregate remaining size reproduce the report.

device_listing.note: Includes virtual and generic registered devices; not a physical component count.
